# ThreatCrush

> All-in-one security agent for builders. ThreatCrush is a Continuous Threat
> Exposure Management (CTEM) platform that monitors, detects, scans, and
> protects servers in real time — open-source CLI, daemon, desktop app, and
> hosted dashboard.

## What We Do
- Real-time threat intelligence and exposure monitoring (CTEM)
- Server agent + daemon: live syslog, auth, firewall, and process telemetry
- Vulnerability and attack-surface scanning across owned properties
- Module marketplace for community-published security checks
- SIEM/EDR/SOC-friendly: open standards, webhook-driven, no vendor lock-in
